sloka: न च कौतूहलं कार्यं सखित्वं प्रति राघव ।कृतकर्मा रणे वीरः सखित्वमनुवेत्स्यसि ।। ६.५०.५७ ।।।।
transliteration: na ca kautūhalaṁ kāryaṁ sakhitvaṁ prati rāghava ।kṛtakarmā raṇe vīraḥ sakhitvamanuvetsyasi ।। 6.50.57 ।।।।

translations.english: "Heroic Rama! No question about your curiosity about our friendship now. After winning the war you will recognize."
